caption:
Dalebrook Tidal Pool, at its best today.
100% recommended, fully protected right now. 19°C in the water. Grab your towel.

Built in 1907, one of Cape Town's oldest and most beloved tidal pools in Kalk Bay, facing east to catch the morning sunrise over False Bay.
